part: Richtek RT9013 3.3 V 500 mA LDO with EN, SOT-23-5

datasheet.jlc_db_url: JLC part page C47773, Datasheet link (smtDataManualFile/...-C47773.pdf)

notes: 2026-10-22 (Alex): Richtek's RT9013-33GB (C47773, Extended, about 311k in stock at JLC) replaced the ME6211C33M5G-N (C82942) so a 30-board order needs no pre-order. Same SOT-23-5 pinout; the schematic keeps KiCad's ME6211C33M5 symbol (KiCad has no RT9013), whose pins match number for number.
Pin 4 is NC on the SOT-23-5 ('No Internal Connection', p2 Functional Pin Description). This revision has no BP pin: the part is the 'without bypass capacitor' version, so nothing is owed to pin 4.
CPL: JLC's library footprint for C47773 is the same one as C82942's (SOT-23-5_L3.0-W1.7-P0.95-LS2.8-BL): no change from the ME6211.

Output capacitor: >= 1 uF ceramic with ESR > 5 mOhm (p8, Figure 1 drawn for 1 uF only). The board has 2 x 10 uF on 3V3_LDO and more on +3V3: low ESR at the floor of the stated range; watch 3V3 for ringing on a load step at bring-up.

ratings.design: VSYS: BQ24073 OUT regulates 4.3-4.5 V with USB in (VO(REG), its datasheet's Electrical Characteristics); VBAT <= 4.2 V without

ratings.limit: 6 V absolute (not tied to VIN); VIH >= 1.6 V, VIL <= 0.6 V; CMOS, must not float
ratings.design: PWR_EN: 0.91 x (VBUS - Vf) from R14/D3 (about 4.3 V at 5 V VBUS), VSYS - Vf from the Start button, 3V3 - Vf from PWR_HOLD; R15 100k pulls it down, as the datasheet's application circuit does. A VBUS above about 6.9 V (a faulty charger) would pass 6 V, through 10k
ratings.cite: p3; p4 Electrical Characteristics; p8 Enable

ratings.limit: 250 mV typ, 400 mV max at 500 mA
ratings.design: 3V3 holds down to VSYS about 3.4-3.5 V at the board's load
3V3 load (core, panel logic, op-amp) well under 500 mA
(4.4 - 3.3) x I3V3 with USB in: 0.4 W at about 360 mA

ratings.limit: CIN >= 1 uF X7R within 0.5 in; COUT >= 1 uF ceramic, ESR > 5 mOhm
ratings.design: C5 10u on VSYS; C6, C7 10u on 3V3_LDO
